purpose: Bind the machine-readable construction/material registry to the actual Unity Material assets used by the benchmark before any formal native-4K evidence frame is rendered. This is source/runtime preflight only and awards no Visual Fidelity points.
limitations: Scalar metallic/roughness validation does not prove the final angular response of texture-modulated or custom BRDF materials; sealed grazing-light pixels remain authoritative.
A passing registry binding cannot clear impossible_material_physics or baked_or_painted_highlights without direct review of the canonical native-4K grazing crops.
This guard intentionally rejects a registered material asset that is no longer bound by any active benchmark renderer; stale metadata must be updated rather than silently accepted.
